result.stdout:
NetSlice CLI - Vertical Slice Architecture Generator for Minimal APIs

USAGE: netslice <command> [options]

COMMANDS: 
  add slice <Feature> <Name> Scaffolds a vertical slice with Endpoint, DTOs, 
                             and Validator.                                  
  add slice                  Starts interactive wizard to configure the      
                             slice.                                          

OPTIONS: 
  -m, --method <METHOD> HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH). Default:
                        GET.                                                 
  -h, --help            Show command line help.                              
  -v, --version         Display current tool version.                        

EXAMPLES: 
  netslice add slice Products CreateProduct -m POST
  netslice add slice Orders GetOrderById -m GET
  netslice add slice  # Launch interactive wizard
